description: Generation-bound admission authority for production-equivalent or production failure drills. Existing local outage, process-kill, parser-restart and candidate mixed-version results remain valid local evidence but cannot satisfy these scenarios by relabeling.

requiredAssertions: at least two distinct runtime node identity digests
failure controller identity is outside the failed node
in-flight work has an explicit success-or-retry outcome
new work routes away from the failed node
shared dependency reconnect succeeds from replacement capacity
session, deletion-fence, idempotency and tenant-isolation invariants remain valid
recovery completion and operator stop conditions are recorded
TLS and scoped runtime credentials are active
outage or partition is observed independently from the application process
ambiguous upload or object state fails closed
no Preview or durable memory commit is created from unavailable object bytes
recovery uses exact object-version authority
retention and lifecycle controls remain enabled
retry after dependency recovery converges without duplicate effects
database primary loss or equivalent failover event is independently observed
connection pool disruption and drain are measured
replacement database endpoint or role is healthy before recovery
expired or revoked sessions do not resurrect
deleted accounts and deletion leases do not resurrect or duplicate
idempotency claims produce no duplicate effects
FORCE RLS and NOBYPASSRLS runtime role invariants are reverified
replication or recovery continuity evidence is bound to the drill
reviewed parser artifact digest is used
parser child process-group termination and orphan/reaping scan are recorded
host or container restart occurs after spool seal and before ResumeCommit
spool storage is remounted from durable storage on replacement runtime
sealed spool checksum and request binding are unchanged
ResumeCommit completes without parser or object-store re-read
no partial spool residue, duplicate Preview or duplicate memory effect remains
